invariants.rationale: The returned HoodieWriteMetadata should not be null as it is created via a method call that returns a new object.
The method relies on preppedRecords for its primary operation; if null, method logic would likely fail earlier.
instantTime is used as a required argument for commit action executor; it should not be null.
The context is required to construct the executor and its nullability should have been checked before execution.
A well-formed HoodieWriteMetadata is expected to hold a non-null collection of WriteStatus instances.
